issue_title: [Bug] next_id 方法在非连续/负数 ID 列表后可能产生重复 ID
summary: Fixed the next_id method in TodoStorage to always return a positive integer (>= 1) that doesn't conflict with existing IDs, even when all existing IDs are negative or zero.
risks: None identified - the fix is minimal and only affects the next_id method
limitations: The fix does not fill gaps in the ID sequence (e.g., [1, 5] returns 6, not 2)
